context.root_cause: test/letflow/scheduler/poller_test.exs:339-352, describe block mislabeled 'AC7: retention runs on Poller's own process -- no second ticker, application.ex untouched'. The test 'lib/letflow/application.ex has zero diff against the base branch' runs `git diff --stat #{base_ref}...HEAD -- lib/letflow/application.ex` where base_ref resolves to whatever origin/main or main CURRENTLY is (via a resolve_base_ref! helper), and asserts empty output. This test maps to NO acceptance criterion in docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-186 entry (10 ACs) and appears nowhere in test/specs/REQ-186.md's AC1-AC10 coverage checklist -- it is undocumented, extra, and mislabeled (the REAL AC7, in both docs/requirements.yaml and test/specs/REQ-186.md, is the unrelated max-fire-retries-to-failed-plus-one-DLQ-row property, already covered by test/letflow/scheduler_test.exs). It encodes a point-in-time fact (REQ-186's own commits happened not to touch application.ex) as a permanent repo-wide invariant, so it fails on every future legitimate commit that touches application.ex for any reason -- which is exactly what REQ-190's already-approved :logger primary-filter registration did. git blame confirms lines 330-352 (helper + both AC7-labeled tests) trace entirely to commit 77637268, REQ-186's original already-merged commit -- not a REQ-190 regression.

task.description:
Design the fix for ISS-0378. Produce a design artefact at lib/letflow/design/iss0378-poller-test-application-ex-diff.md (no implementation code) covering:

1. Confirm the recommended approach: DELETE the 'lib/letflow/application.ex has zero diff against the base branch' test and its now-unused resolve_base_ref!/0 helper from test/letflow/scheduler/poller_test.exs entirely, rather than narrowing the git-diff scope -- it maps to no acceptance criterion in docs/requirements.yaml or test/specs/REQ-186.md, so there is no coverage to preserve. State explicitly whether you agree or, if not, what narrower structural (non-git-diff) check you propose instead and why deletion alone is insufficient.
2. If a replacement structural assertion is warranted at all (e.g. asserting the Poller's child spec is present/correctly configured in the application's supervision tree via a real function call, never via `git diff`), specify it precisely: which function to call (find and name Letflow.Application's actual public/introspectable surface for its child list -- do not invent a function name), what shape the assertion takes, and confirm it does not depend on git/history in any way.
3. Address the mislabeled describe block: the surviving 'lib/letflow/scheduler/ contains exactly one GenServer module' test currently sits under a describe titled 'AC7: ...' when the real AC7 is unrelated (max-fire-retries -> failed -> one DLQ row, already covered in scheduler_test.exs) and this test isn't in test/specs/REQ-186.md's coverage matrix under any AC number either. Specify the corrected describe title (should not claim an AC number it isn't mapped to).
4. Confirm scope: this fix touches ONLY test/letflow/scheduler/poller_test.exs. Do NOT design a fix for test/letflow/scheduler_req188_test.exs's identical pattern (transition.ex) -- that is a separate, out-of-scope recurrence for ORCH to file as its own issue.

Design must be unambiguous enough for TEST-DESIGNER/ELIXIR-DEV (whichever WF-03 routes to for the actual edit -- this is a test-file-only change) to implement without making further design decisions. Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR per WF-03 Steps 2-4 once done.
